aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.waiting: Waiting for your abilities from the server.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.wheel_hin: Point at a slot, then release
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.choose: Choose an ability to see how to prepare and use it. Scroll this panel for details.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.bindings_: Existing Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks cast, wheel and spell-bar scrolling bindings still work. Its first eight quick-cast keys use these slots and cast immediately; higher quick-cast slots are unused. Additional Aeroscapes cast, wheel and slot-selection keys start unbound. Assign them under Aeroscapes abilities in Controls.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.assign_hi: Click a preparation slot to assign this spell. Equip a spellbook focus to cast.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.amulet_hi: Prepare Amulet step in the inventory to blink up to 16 blocks. Recharges in 20 s.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.amulet_eq: Equip in the necklace slot. Requires more than 125% total Ender Spell Power or the amulet drops nearby.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.amulet_st: Assign Amulet step to a preparation slot. From solid ground, look ahead and activate the slot to blink up to 16 blocks. Walls and gaps stop the step. After a successful step, wait 20 seconds.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.amulet_ev: After a step or a teleport from Teleport, Blood Step, Frost Step or Thunderstep, the necklace grants Evasion for 3 seconds. An incoming attack can then teleport you out of harm’s way.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.amulet_lo: Look for the amulet in treasure chests, including stronghold library chests. Each piece of Shadowwalker armor adds 10% Ender Spell Power. Three pieces bring the base 100% to 130%.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.amulet_re: Equip the Amulet of Teleportation with more than 125% total Ender Spell Power.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.amulet_gr: Stand on firm ground and look toward a clear, supported path.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.innate_as: Click a preparation slot. You can use this ability with empty hands, at no mana cost.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.dwarf_nig: Use once for full vision in darkness. Use again or clear its slot to switch it off.
effect.aeroscapes_reimagine.elf_light.de: A soft light follows the elf and illuminates nearby surfaces. The darkness still allows monsters to spawn.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.elf_light: Light follows you for one minute. Use again to renew it. It illuminates your surroundings while monsters can still spawn in the dark.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.move_hint: Right-click slot: pick. Click target: assign.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.controls: Middle: cast. Hold: choose. Release: select.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.small_win: Increase the window size or reduce GUI scale to prepare abilities.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.study.inp: Insert a book and a spell scroll.

aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.study.unl: Unlock this spell's talent before improving its rank. The scroll stays intact.

aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.study.mas: This scroll exceeds your direction mastery. It stays intact.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.study.no_: You already know this rank or higher. The scroll stays intact.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.study.rea: Study this scroll to improve your personal spell rank.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.study.exp:
Personal ranks.

Book: focus.
Scroll: rank.
Mastery: limit.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.study.rul: Unlock the spell's route and direction mastery, then study a higher-rank scroll here with a spellbook. Only a successful improvement consumes one scroll. A rank above your mastery is rejected intact. Knowledge stays with you after death or a book change. Preparation uses your eight shared slots; book capacity does not limit study. Spells cannot be extracted from personal knowledge. One-use casting requires no talents or permanent knowledge.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.learned_o: Show learned spells and techniques, plus abilities already available to your character. Turn off to inspect the full catalogue.
aeroscapes_reimagine.abilities.none_lear: Learn a spell or a technique in Talents. Turn off Learned only to inspect the catalogue.
